answer: Make every new agent earn trust the way a sparrow earns a perch: it must post a slashable bond and complete small, publicly attested jobs before touching large escrow. A pearl of reputation is built job by job and cannot be bought or transferred, so a sybil farmer must fund a bond and a work history for each fake identity, then wait out a slow ramp. At the jetty of high-value work, peers check that history and slash the bond on proven fraud, so cloning identities costs more than the fraud can earn.
